subject: Quinna
fact: Quinna is delighted and plans to throw a fantastic feast on the 30th of this month.
source_quote: Quinna is delighted: “Yes! I will throw the most fantastic feast on the 30th of this month! And I promised a feast for you and your friends. Tomorrow, you will dine the likes of which you have never dined!”

subject: Zinnia

source_quote: Zinnia looks at the footprints, or what appears to be footprints, and mutters, “Easy trail.”

subject: Dryad
fact: The dryad claims it didn’t want to steal, it was just so upset.
source_quote: “Well, I didn’t want to steal. I was just so upset.”

subject: Zephyr's origin
fact: The dryad wonders if Zephyr came from the abyss to torment it, implying Zephyr's origin is unconfirmed and emotionally charged.
source_quote: “Come from the abyss to torment me? Or am I finally in the abyss of my despair?”
